speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) whether the number of home rental scams using online platforms has increased in the past 12 months; and (b) whether the Ministry will consider introducing further safeguards to protect homeowners whose homes have been used in such scams from liabilities.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: These cases generally involved scammers impersonating property agents and listing home rentals on online platforms.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Victims who come across these listings would contact the scammers via the phone numbers on the listings.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The scammers would impersonate legitimate property agents by sending the victims pictures of a legitimate property agent's business card, as well as pictures or videos of the home units to be leased.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: There were also cases where the scammers posed as landlords.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: In both these variants, the scammers would inform the victims that they are required to place a deposit in order to secure a viewing or to rent the unit.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: After the victims transfer the monies to the scammers, the scammers would become uncontactable.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The best defence is a vigilant and discerning public.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: We also encourage the public to verify the identity of the persons with whom they are dealing with.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: If the person claims to be a property agent, please verify their identity via the CEA Public Register.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: They can also contact the person's property agency before entering into any dealings with them.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: If a search of the advertised phone number does not lead to the property agent's profile page, this could be an indication that the listing is a scam, even if the property agent's name or registration number has been verified against the CEA Public Register.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: Given that there has been an uptick of home rental scams using online platforms as the conduit, will the Ministry be taking ownership and enforcement measures against this online host?

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: One Punggol resident who saw me at a Meet-the-People session told me that his home had been used, not once, but multiple times in home rental scams and he had multiple victims turn up at his doorstep over a period of a few months with their belongings ready to move in.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: Thankfully, the victims understood that my resident had nothing to do with the scam.

speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: However, for home owners whose homes and identities had inadvertently been used in these rental scams, what protections would be afforded to them from the Government, should civil suits and Police investigations be launched against them?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: As I mentioned, the most important thing is to verify that the so-called estate agent is a bona fide estate agent.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: You can do so by looking at the phone number that is being advertised, check it against the CEA public register.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: It is a simple search function: just put in the phone number and if that phone number is a legitimate one, it will then lead you to the details of the estate agent who is registered with CEA.
